version.changelog: Initial release: read-only access to Hedy sessions, transcripts, highlights, todos, topics, and contexts via the REST API. Supports US and EU region endpoints.

vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: hedy
Version: 1.0.0

The 'hedy' skill is a legitimate integration for accessing Hedy meeting data (transcripts, highlights, and todos) via its official REST API (api.hedy.bot). It uses standard tools like curl and jq, follows best practices by using environment variables for authentication, and includes explicit safety instructions in SKILL.md to prevent API key leakage and ensure data privacy.

llm.summary: The skill's requirements and runtime instructions are consistent with its stated purpose (read-only Hedy meeting data) and request only a single API key plus curl/jq; no install or unrelated privileges are present.

dimensions.detail: Name/description ask for read-only Hedy meeting data and the skill only requires HEDY_API_KEY, curl, and jq — all directly relevant and proportional to the stated functionality.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md contains only API usage and config instructions for querying Hedy endpoints. Minor caution: it advises storing the API key in ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json (plaintext config) and gives Docker sandbox injection instructions; these are implementation details that affect secrecy of the key but are within scope of enabling the skill.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Instruction-only skill with no install spec and no downloaded code — lowest-risk installation footprint.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only a single credential (HEDY_API_KEY) is required, which matches the service. User should confirm the API key's scope/permissions and be aware the README suggests storing it in a local JSON config (plaintext).
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Skill does not request always:true or other elevated persistence; default autonomous invocation is allowed but not combined with other red flags.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and limited to reading Hedy data. Before installing: 1) Confirm the HEDY_API_KEY you create is scoped/read-only if possible and rotate it if compromised. 2) Avoid keeping long-lived secrets in plaintext config files if you can store the key in a secrets manager or environment variables with proper permissions. 3) If you run OpenClaw in a sandbox, follow the provided sandbox guidance carefully so the key is placed where you intend (note: the SKILL.md mentions how openclaw.json values get injected). 4) Verify you trust the domain(s) api.hedy.bot / eu-api.hedy.bot and the Hedy service policy for data access, since transcripts and meeting content can be sensitive. If you need stronger controls, require scoped API tokens or limit agent autonomy when interacting with meeting data.
